\section{Mathematics and document formatting}
The ordinary least-squares coefficient is
\[
  \widehat\beta = \left(X'X\right)^{-1}X'y,
  \qquad
  \operatorname{Var}(\widehat\beta\mid X)
  = \sigma^2\left(X'X\right)^{-1}.
\]
A paired expression uses \texttt{mathtools}:
\[
  \begin{dcases}
    y_i = x_i'\beta + \varepsilon_i, & i \in \mathcal{I},\\
    E[\varepsilon_i\mid x_i]=0. &
  \end{dcases}
\]

\begin{enumerate}[label=\textcolor{blue!60!black}{\arabic*.},leftmargin=*]
  \item Hyperlinks are available through \href{https://example.invalid}{a synthetic URL}.
  \item Literal addresses use \url{https://example.invalid/texpdf}.
\end{enumerate}
